success.description: Whether SLSQP converged to a feasible solution

totalCost.description: Σ k_i / T_i^p_i at the optimum

predictedYieldPct.description: Yield predicted by the fast RSS/normal-approximation model used inside the optimizer's constraint — not the same computation as the Monte Carlo verification below.

monteCarloVerification.description: A real Monte Carlo run (statistics/monte_carlo.py) using the optimized tolerances, to check the fast analytic model against simulation. A large gap from predictedYieldPct usually means the stack-up is meaningfully non-normal (see skewness/kurtosis).
